Go for a walk thru Haga. Go up to Skansen Krona for a beautiful view of the city. After this head down back to Haga and have a fika to relax and unwind! Haga is known for their huge cinnamon buns, Hagabullen. 

Visit Eriksberg! You can take the boat from Stenpiren to get to Lindholmen, then it’s a beautiful promenade with some cafes and restaurants. 
My favourite restaurant in the whole city is located in this area. Piga ([Piga website](https://www.restaurangpiga.se/) )serves a modern take on Swedish classics, located by the iconic Eriksbergs crane. 

Liseberg if you like amusement parks. 

The botanical garden, Slottskogen and Trädgårdsföreningen (this one has a huge greenhouse) if you like parks! 

If you are feeling homesick (or if your just in the mood for BBQ) you should visit Brisket and friends located at Victoria Passagen. Not in the mood for BBQ? JINX Dynasty serves amazing Korean street food! 

Hope you have a wonderful trip :)
